message: Newton did not converge after {iters} iterations (residual {residual})
description: The nonlinear solver did not find a solution within its iteration budget. The residual is how far the circuit's equations still were from being satisfied. Common causes are a model whose current changes very steeply (an exponential with no limiting), a node with no DC path to ground, or a starting point far from the solution.
actions: Give Newton a better starting point with `.nodeset V(net)=value` for the nets you can estimate.
Check that every node has a DC path to ground.
In a model, limit steep exponentials (`limexp`, or `$limit` on the junction voltage).
